name: Sarah Johnson
text: Smart Travel made our Sri Lanka honeymoon absolutely magical! Every detail was perfectly planned. The guides were knowledgeable and friendly. We'll treasure these memories forever.

name: Marcus Williams
text: Best travel experience I've ever had! The tours were well-organized, the locations breathtaking, and the local insights invaluable. Highly recommend Smart Travel for anyone visiting Sri Lanka.

name: Priya Patel
text: Exceeded all expectations! From whale watching to temple visits, every tour was extraordinary. The booking process was seamless and customer service exceptional. Will definitely book again!

name: Thomas Anderson
text: Sri Lanka is stunning and Smart Travel showed us the very best of it. Professional guides, comfortable transport, and unforgettable experiences. This trip changed my life!
